title: core-shell, billing, reports pass owner from package.json team

summary: validateApp now throws if owner missing/empty; core-shell, billing, reports pass owner from their package.json team (platform/payments/insights). Single PR #1 in mono, CI+CD green. Assumptions: owner values hardcoded to match package.json team (apps can't read package.json in the browser bundle); reports isn't deployed by CD so it's only covered by the contract change.
